description: This file defines a class 'Map' within the OpenCart admin dashboard extension. It manages the dashboard map's display, configuration settings, saving settings, and retrieving map data related to orders by country. The class utilizes OpenCart's framework for loading language files, views, models, and handling HTTP responses.

classes.name: Map
classes.description: Controller class for managing the dashboard map component in the admin panel, including rendering the map configuration, saving settings, and fetching map data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the dashboard map configuration page, setting up breadcrumbs, loading necessary views and scripts, and passing configuration data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of dashboard map settings. Checks permissions, updates settings via model, and returns success or error as JSON.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Returns the view for the dashboard map, possibly including inline scripts or styles (commented out).

methods.name: map
methods.description: Retrieves order data by country via model, formats it as JSON, and returns it, typically for display on the map.
